title: Original mini-games: Hockey, Treasure Hunt, King of the Hills
summary: Three original mini-game titles restored and playable: Hockey on Coonce Arena with the original puck model and sounds, Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills with 28 new courses, plus a new Games menu page. Single player only; Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills require release-owner R2 publication.
details: Hockey recovered from QuadzillaEventHockey.cpp with face-off geometry, drop, goals, hat tricks, crowd/siren/puck sound events and restart. PR #345 added hockey::hockey and hockey::tag core rules; #346 brought the puck 3D model, original sounds and results page; #347 unified Hockey with Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills into a new Games framework (atv_core::games) with the Games menu, course selection and time-limit options.

Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills rules recovered from QuadzillaEventTreasureHunt and QuadzillaEventKingOfTheHill with exact-build evidence. Treasure Hunt collects treasures in groups (6 s wait between groups); King of the Hills captures hilltops by landing grounded. Single Player → Games page now launches Hockey (Coonce Arena), Treasure Hunt (14 courses), or King of the Hills (14 courses). Profile Store gates the two locked games; Hockey and Tag are open on a new profile.

Browser tests (test_engine_hockey_tag, test_engine_games) pass with the full content package. Hockey one-shot sounds (siren02.vag, gameover.vag, puck1/puck2.vag, crowd reactions) play with the regenerated AUDIO.RES. Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills game archives are packaged as lazy deltas (7–10 KB each) awaiting release-owner R2 publication.
limitation: Single player only (original mini-games are split-screen/online; CPU logic not implemented). Tag is core-only but not yet playable without opponents and archived courses. Hockey sounds depend on release-owner publishing the regenerated content package; other games work silently with the current hosted package. Treasure Hunt and King of the Hills courses and collision triggers remain unverified for physical play without release-owner archive publication. Team Select, Time Limit row, team marker quads, hockey camera, hat emitters and treasure/hill score pills are not drawn. Puck drawn as screen tag and 3D model (larger than contact radius); bomb/flag/spotlight particle effects not emitted.
